title: SOAR Automation Broker patch 8.7.0.245 is missing from the guide’s maintenance evidence
problem: Splunk’s separate Broker notes date 8.7.0.245 to October 9 and explicitly limit its distribution to Docker Hub. The checked canonical SOAR Broker record names Python 3.13 in 8.7 and earlier 8.6.0.536 fixes but omits 8.7.0.245. The 8.8 HA section distinguishes Cloud activation from single-instance on-premises setup. This observation is a gap in the guide’s selected Broker maintenance coverage. It establishes no fixed issue, advisory remediation, SOAR server build or recommendation to install the Broker patch.
